column2: Terraform provisions all required resources (networking, SG, EC2, IAM); inputs are sensible and documented; SG rules are minimal and justified.
column6: All required resources are provisioned cleanly; variables are well-named with defaults; SG rules are minimal, justified, and correctly scoped.
column9: Resources are provisioned correctly; minor gaps in variable documentation or SG justification.
column12: Some resources are provisioned but significant gaps remain in networking, IAM, or SG configuration.
column15: Terraform code is incomplete, broken, or does not provision the required infrastructure.

column2: Ansible playbook configures the server from blank EC2 to running service; playbook is idempotent; tasks are clear and ordered.
column6: Playbook is idempotent and complete: installs prerequisites, authenticates to ECR, pulls pinned image, configures storage, starts service. Re-run produces no errors or changes.
column9: Playbook works end-to-end with minor idempotency issues or one unclear task.
column12: Playbook partially configures the server; significant manual intervention still required.
column15: No Ansible playbook provided, or playbook does not produce a working service.

column2: GitHub Actions workflow builds Docker image and pushes to ECR on git tag; includes a smoke test; at least one successful run is evidenced.
column6: Workflow triggers on tag, builds image, runs smoke test, pushes to ECR. Successful run is clearly evidenced. Workflow is clean and well-structured.
column9: Pipeline works but smoke test is weak or workflow structure has minor issues.
column12: Pipeline exists but does not complete successfully, or key steps (tag trigger, smoke test, push) are missing.
column15: No CI/CD pipeline provided, or pipeline does not build/push images.

column2: A destroy/apply cycle (plus Ansible) produces a joinable Minecraft server; world data recovery strategy is documented.
column6: Destroy + apply + Ansible produces a joinable server shown in video; world data strategy is documented and defensible.
column9: Rebuild works but video evidence has minor gaps, or world data strategy is documented but not fully demonstrated.
column12: Partial rebuild evidence; server does not fully recover or strategy documentation is vague.
column15: No rebuild proof provided, or destroy/apply does not produce a working server.

column2: Architecture diagram, variable docs, teardown checklist, and change process are complete and skimmable.
column6: All documentation sections are present, accurate, and usable by another operator: diagram shows AWS resources + Ansible flow + CI/CD pipeline; change process is clear; teardown checklist prevents cost waste.
column9: Documentation is mostly complete with minor gaps or ambiguity in one section.
column12: Documentation is partial; multiple sections are missing or too vague to be useful.
column15: Documentation is largely missing or not usable by another operator.
